theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_frame_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ g → (volume : Measure (Fin k → ℝ)).map (fun u => ∑ i, u i • g i) = μHE[k].restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μHE[k] {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k) ∧ μHE[k] {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| < r} = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k)
